body.query: how do I keep track of an important message
documents:
Delete a message › Delete a message completely

In some cases, such as when a message accidentally shares secret information, or contains spam or abuse, it makes sense to delete a message completely.

Star a message › Star a message

**Desktop/Web:**
1. Hover over a message to reveal three icons on the right.
2. Click the **star** icon.

**Tip:** You can unstar a message using the same instructions used to star it.
